For all the settings except Http2 the default value is `True` if the service was created on or before April 1, 2018 and `False` otherwise. Http2 setting's default value is `False`.</br></br>You can disable any of the following ciphers by using settings `Microsoft.WindowsAzure.ApiManagement.Gateway.Security.Ciphers.[cipher_name]`: TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA, TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA, TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA, TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA, TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256, TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA256, TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA256, TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA, TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA.
